items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: I'm standing in between Eleanor Roosevelt and Orson Welles... when I spoke with Mrs. Roosevelt

ctx.x: And I had no idea that these people would be there, because I just went to Sarah Vaughan, we were just going to do our act and play and get offstage, you know? So I went to get a bite to eat, and I'm standing in between Eleanor Roosevelt and Orson Welles. And at that point Orson Welles, he looked just about like he looked in 'Citizen Kane,' you know, he had that same look at that point, you know?
